bacchus' wand.name: Bacchus' Wand
bacchus' wand.lore: An undeniable work of craftsmanship, less so of taste. The words “To my sweet Flavien" are carefully engraved on the underside of the shaft.

argent and vert.name: Argent and Vert
argent and vert.lore: “Let the bells of Lucca toll. Let them wake the dead so that we may fight."

hohenzollern reborn.name: Hohenzollern Reborn
hohenzollern reborn.lore: We shall rebuild the Holy Empire.

lion of rotterdam.name: Lion of Rotterdam
lion of rotterdam.lore: Though Rotterdam was defended until the end by a single man, the strength of fire were as though one hundred fought.

treaty workhorse.name: Treaty Workhorse
treaty workhorse.lore: Taken from one of the dead among the North Treaty after their attempt to liberate Aachen.

veenstra's swine.name: Veenstra's Swine
veenstra's swine.lore: Plucked from the cold hands of a Frisian nobleman.

honoured agreement.name: Honoured Agreement
honoured agreement.lore: “Nemo plus iuris ad alium transferre potest quam ipse habet."

eastern promise.name: Eastern Promise
eastern promise.lore: His gaze does not command - it endures. Through smoke and snow, war and winter, the face of the Lord remains unchanging: solemn, infinite, and still. It is said the icon darkened during the Great Famine, as though taking on the weight of the people's suffering.

recluse.name: Recluse
recluse.lore: The product of a hermit who occupied the darkest places in Vosges’ woods. An axe tempered in wild-flowing springs.

angler's sack.name: Angler's Sack
angler's sack.lore: A comfort in the rushing waters.

bosun's clasp.name: Bosun's Clasp
bosun's clasp.lore: Salt-cracked leather and a brass lock weathered by a hundred storms - this bag once hung at the waist of a ship’s bosun who never left a deck without it.

partisan.name: Partisan
partisan.lore: In the last days of the End a peasant pulled iron from his yard and bound it with leather. It was not a soldier’s weapon, nor the work of a smith. He made it for the men who came with fire and rope. You can see the hurry in its making, and the anger too.

hybernia.name: Hybernia
hybernia.lore: A spike of blue metal, hammered straight. It is too heavy for hunting, too plain for ceremony. The point catches the light oddly, as if wet.

peasant's burden.name: Peasant's Burden
peasant's burden.lore: The poor man’s weapon - easy to make, simple to use, and deadly enough when it matters.
